preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of officers N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The initial coordinate of Chef C must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= P[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each officer's initial coordinate P[i] must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(set(P)) == N and C not in P
preconditions.description: All officer coordinates must be unique and different from Chef's coordinate.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of the maximum number of officers eliminated and whether Chef runs away (1) or is caught (-1).
The maximum number of officers eliminated must be non-negative.
The result must indicate either that Chef runs away (1) or is caught (-1).
